scenario_results.name: Unambiguous Count Scalar Template
assertion_details: format_scalar_template('StudentCount', 42) == 'Count: 42' [got 'Count: 42']
AnswerSynthesisService produced TEMPLATE_DETERMINISTIC with is_mechanically_verified=True
scenario_results.limitation_note: Token-based template heuristic formats unambiguous aggregate column names; does not inspect query AST.

scenario_results.name: Unambiguous Average, Min, and Max Templates
assertion_details: Verified unambiguous average prefix ('Average: 87.5')
Verified unambiguous minimum prefix ('Minimum: 35')
Verified unambiguous maximum prefix ('Maximum: 3.95')
scenario_results.limitation_note: Recognizes tokens 'avg', 'average', 'mean', 'min', 'lowest', 'max', 'highest'; relies on non-conflicting naming.

scenario_results.name: Neutral Formatting for Ambiguous / Non-Count Columns
assertion_details: Column 'total_revenue' formatted neutrally without assuming Count
Column 'discount_pct' formatted neutrally
Conflicting aggregate column 'min_max_spread' fell back neutrally
Synthesizer appended neutral-formatting disclosure note

notes: Scalar column does not match standard aggregate naming; formatted neutrally.

scenario_results.limitation_note: Does not guess semantic meaning when column names contain ambiguous or non-count keywords.

scenario_results.name: Deterministic Empty Result Set Handling
assertion_details: synthesize() returns EMPTY_RESULT with is_mechanically_verified=True on 0 rows
synthesize_from_metadata() grounds 0-row outcome directly from metadata
scenario_results.limitation_note: Verifies empty-result deterministic short-circuit; assumes upstream execution correctly reported 0 rows.

scenario_results.name: Heuristic Detection of Fabricated Currency Claims
assertion_details: Detected fabricated dollar symbol '$' in text
Detected euro (€), pound (£), rupee (₹), and yen (¥) symbols
synthesize_from_metadata safely downgraded currency hallucination to REQUIRES_ROW_DISCLOSURE
scenario_results.limitation_note: Heuristic regex check flags currency symbols; cannot detect non-currency financial claims (e.g. '500 dollars').

scenario_results.name: Heuristic Detection of Unsupported Numeric Constants
assertion_details: Detected ungrounded numeric constant '99.5' outside allowed metadata bounds
Permitted grounded numbers matching metadata, SQL, and latency without false alarm
scenario_results.limitation_note: Bounds check checks whether numbers exist in {row_count, column count, latency, question, SQL}; does not verify semantic truth.

scenario_results.name: Faithful Multi-Row Narrative Classification as Unverified
assertion_details: Multi-row LLM output classified strictly as UNVERIFIED_NARRATIVE with is_mechanically_verified=False
scenario_results.limitation_note: Enforces the policy that LLM prose is never marked mechanically verified; does not verify semantic completeness.

scenario_results.name: Entity Query Pre-screening for Required Row Disclosure
assertion_details: Correctly flagged all 5 entity queries as requiring row disclosure
synthesize_from_metadata safely refused cloud synthesis under zero-disclosure policy
scenario_results.limitation_note: Pattern-based heuristic looks for question phrasing (who, which, what is, list); may not catch novel paraphrases.

scenario_results.name: Metadata-Answerable Query Classification
assertion_details: Non-entity question passed pre-screening without requiring row disclosure
Produced GROUNDED_FROM_METADATA response for metadata-only query

evidence_data.summary: The query processed 15 rows in 8.5 ms.

scenario_results.limitation_note: Demonstrates that metadata-only queries can proceed when no cell disclosure is required.

scenario_results.name: AST SQL Literal Masking & Fail-Closed Protection
assertion_details: AST parser masked string and numeric literals while preserving tables, columns, and operators
mask_sql_literals returned None on unparseable SQL AST (fail-closed)

evidence_data.masked_sql: SELECT * FROM Students WHERE Email = '[REDACTED_VALUE]' AND Age >= '[REDACTED_NUMBER]' AND Score > '[REDACTED_NUMBER]'

scenario_results.limitation_note: Relies on sqlglot AST parsing; dialect-specific syntax errors fall back closed to None.

scenario_results.name: Truncation Disclosures on Sampled Results
assertion_details: synthesize() attached truncation disclosure note to GroundedAnswer
synthesize_from_metadata attached truncation caveat note

notes: Results were truncated at the system limit; narrative reflects only retrieved sample.
evidence_data.metadata_note: Results were truncated at the system limit; narrative reflects only retrieved count.

scenario_results.limitation_note: Verifies that truncation metadata is attached; does not evaluate whether prose itself discusses truncation.

scenario_results.name: Provider Failure and Timeout Safe Fallback
assertion_details: synthesize() caught TimeoutError and safely fell back to SYNTHESIS_FAILED
synthesize_from_metadata caught provider error and returned UNAVAILABLE

evidence_data.fallback_text: Query executed successfully. Refer to the data table for results.

scenario_results.limitation_note: Tests safe error handling and graceful degradation; does not retry transient provider failures.
